ALPHABET CENTER · LETTER V

Letter V — Violin.

A purple violin sings in for the letter V. V vibrates like a tiny motor — vvv — and the violin is the best motor in the orchestra.

Meet the letter, hear its sound, trace it together — then play. Everything on this page is free, gentle and paced for you.

THE LETTER SOUND

What does V say?

“v — vvv, a motor sound”

V says vvv — like a little motor: top teeth on the bottom lip, voice switched on. Hold it out: vvvv. Compare with f, which is the same shape but only air.

TRACE THE LETTER

Trace V v together.

Follow the numbers with a finger — on screen or on each other’s palms. The arrows show the way to go, the numbers show where to start, and a grown-up reads the little script below each card. Slow and wobbly is exactly right.

Trace the uppercase V

Start at 1 at the top left, slide down to the point. Lift. Start at 2 at the point, slide up to the top right.

Trace the lowercase v

Start at 1 at the top left, slide down to the point. Lift. Start at 2 at the point, slide up to the top right.

TAKE IT OFF SCREEN

Violin concert.

Two minutes is plenty. Follow your child’s lead and stop while it is still fun — that is the whole method.

  1. 01

    Hold a ruler or paper tube as a violin and bow with your other arm while singing vvvv.

  2. 02

    March once around the room playing for an audience of stuffed animals.

  3. 03

    Finish with a deep bow — v is for very well done.

PLAY & PRACTICE

Games that use this letter.

The games mix every letter — play them after meeting two or three letters, or any day your child asks. No scores, no timers, no wrong answers that count.
